title: CROWDGUARD v2.0 Crowd Risk Engine Validation & Temporal Reliability
calibration_disclaimer: Scientific Integrity Disclaimer: Risk scores represent an uncalibrated heuristic index (0-100) synthesized from weighted DIP features for operator decision support. They must NOT be interpreted as absolute calibrated probabilities of stampedes, crushes, injuries, or real-world disasters.

scenario_matrix.name: Empty Scene Baseline (Zero Density, Zero Flow)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: All components evaluate to 0.0; raw and smoothed scores exactly 0.0; band is Low.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: 0 count, 0 flow, 0 speed yields 0.0 for density, growth, motion anomaly, and congestion.

observed_metrics.explanation: Crowd movement and spatial distribution are within standard baseline parameters

scenario_matrix.limitations: Assumes camera is active and transmitting genuine empty frames rather than a black/frozen stream.

scenario_matrix.name: Sparse Pedestrian Movement (Routine Transit)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Low risk (< 25.0); low density occupancy with normal walking speed.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Density component < 0.1, growth component 0, motion component 0.15; score under 10.0.

observed_metrics.explanation: Crowd movement and spatial distribution are within standard baseline parameters

scenario_matrix.limitations: Does not differentiate between leisurely walking and fast walking in open spaces.

scenario_matrix.name: Moderate Congregation (Dispersed Pedestrian Queue)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Score between 12.0 and 30.0; mild occupancy without severe localized bottlenecking.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Density component ~0.23, motion component 0.25; total weighted score remains bounded.

observed_metrics.explanation: Crowd movement and spatial distribution are within standard baseline parameters

scenario_matrix.limitations: Queue geometries that wrap across multiple cells are treated identically to dispersed groups.

scenario_matrix.name: Increasing Crowd Density Sequence (2 -> 25 Persons)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Density component increases strictly monotonically; positive influx growth registered; score ascends into Moderate/High.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Linear density term (C/25)*0.7 scales monotonically; (C - baseline)/8.0 detects influx.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Influx detection is sensitive to the 15-frame rolling window size.

scenario_matrix.name: Localized Concentration vs Uniform Dispersion (N=18)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Focal bottleneck produces significantly higher congestion component (1.0 vs 0.17) and higher risk score (+25 pts delta).
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Concentration ratio (max_cluster / total_count) scales congestion component up to 1.0.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Evaluates 2D image-space grid clustering. Does not incorporate real-world metric floor-plan dimensions.

scenario_matrix.name: Standstill Bottleneck Crush (High Density, Near-Zero Speed)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Triggers standstill crush rule: motion_anomaly_comp forced to 0.8 despite optical flow being low.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Rule `if current_count > 8 and mean_speed < 0.5: motion_anomaly_comp = 0.8` captures dangerous crush standstills.

observed_metrics.explanation: Elevated crowd concentration (16 persons detected) • Abnormal motion vectors or optical flow velocity surge • High spatial clustering/localized bottleneck in monitored zone

scenario_matrix.limitations: May trigger on stationary spectator crowds or seated audiences if not excluded via exclusion zones.

scenario_matrix.name: Turbulent Motion Surge (Running / Panic Velocity)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: High optical flow saturates motion anomaly component to 1.0; risk score elevated to Moderate/High.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: min(1.0, optical_flow_mag / 8.0) caps at 1.0 when optical flow exceeds 8.0 px/frame.

observed_metrics.explanation: Abnormal motion vectors or optical flow velocity surge

scenario_matrix.limitations: Camera shake or sudden lighting flashes can generate high optical flow without genuine human movement.

scenario_matrix.name: Sustained Congestion (20 Frames of Dense Crowd)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Growth component decays to 0.0 as baseline count adapts; score settles into stable steady-state equilibrium.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Once history window of 15 frames fills with 25, current_count - baseline_count = 0, eliminating growth bonus.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Long-term crowd danger may remain elevated even when growth component drops to zero.

scenario_matrix.name: Crowd Dispersal & Exponential EMA Decay
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Raw score drops to 0.0 immediately; smoothed score decays strictly monotonically via (1 - alpha) = 0.70 multiplier with zero oscillation.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Smoothed score evolves as S_t = 0.3*(0) + 0.7*S_{t-1} = 0.70^k * S_peak.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Does not model crowds that disperse slowly in phases or disperse towards another bottleneck zone.

scenario_matrix.name: Missing Telemetry & None Guards
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: No unhandled exceptions; missing optical flow and speed default gracefully to 0.0; congestion falls back to count/30.0.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Input sanitization handles None inputs safely without NaN propagation.

observed_metrics.explanation: Crowd movement and spatial distribution are within standard baseline parameters

scenario_matrix.limitations: Missing speed prevents standstill crush detection from triggering.

scenario_matrix.name: Invalid Numerical Inputs (NaN, Infinity, Negative Counts)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Inputs clamped cleanly to valid ranges [0.0, 100.0]; negative count clamped to 0; no NaN/Inf leaks into outputs.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: np.nan_to_num and max(0, count) guards ensure numerical safety against arithmetic exceptions.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Extreme positive counts (> 100) saturate density component at 1.0; cannot distinguish 100 from 1,000 people.

scenario_matrix.name: Independent Multi-Camera Sessions Concurrency
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Strict state isolation across cameras; Camera B remains at 0.0 despite Camera A experiencing extreme congestion.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: Each CameraSession maintains its own dedicated CrowdRiskEngine instance with independent count_history and EMA states.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Does not perform cross-camera re-identification or track global crowd migration between adjacent camera fields of view.

scenario_matrix.name: Camera Disconnection & Stale Telemetry Flagging
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Telemetry marks is_stale: True and is_connected: False; prevents disconnected feed from being assumed active or zero-risk.
scenario_matrix.formula_rationale: CameraSession.get_telemetry() decorates cached telemetry with live connection status under state lock.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Preserved score remains visible until operator dismisses or reconnects stream.

scenario_matrix.name: Clean Slate Reconnection (No Stale Risk Carry-Over)
scenario_matrix.expected_behavior: Reconnection clears historical count buffer and smoothed risk state to 0.0, avoiding spurious alert carry-over.
scenario_matrix.limitations: Immediate post-reconnection frame operates as a cold start.

temporal_dynamics.smoothing_behavior_note: When last_smoothed_risk == 0.0, cold start snaps directly to raw_score. Subsequent state transitions follow exponential moving average (alpha=0.3).

All 18 persons packed into single central cell

spatial_sensitivity.architectural_gap_notice: The current risk engine implements 2D image-space spatial clustering via a 3x3 grid. It does NOT perform metric floor-plan bottleneck calculations (e.g., people per square metre) because camera calibration matrices and metric site geometry are not configured.

duplicate_detection_impact.description: Evaluates Phase 4.7D real_f145 duplicate detection (+1 false person on 5-person scene)
duplicate_detection_impact.conclusion: Single duplicate false positive causes only +0.98 pt shift (< 1%), proving detector noise does not cause false alarms.

missed_detection_impact.description: Evaluates single false negative (-1 person on 5-person scene)

occlusion_transient_dampening.description: Evaluates abrupt count drop (15 -> 3 persons) due to camera obstruction
occlusion_transient_dampening.conclusion: EMA smoothing prevents instantaneous collapse, maintaining protective alert level during momentary visual occlusion.

evidence_hierarchy_distinction.unit_test_evidence: Deterministic synthetic numerical vectors verified via pytest assertions.
evidence_hierarchy_distinction.controlled_scenario_evidence: 14 calibrated behavioral cases testing monotonicity, saturation, and decay.
evidence_hierarchy_distinction.recorded_video_evidence: Natural surveillance sequences (vid_2e28e1e65a) tested in Phase 4.7D.
evidence_hierarchy_distinction.live_camera_evidence: Real-time webcam and RTSP ingestion verified in Phase 4.7A/4.7B.
evidence_hierarchy_distinction.real_world_incident_validation: UNVERIFIED: System has NOT undergone validation during actual mass-casualty crowd disasters.
